h1: City Park Hotel Phatthalung — big, clean rooms and easy parking right in the heart of town
intro: If you're driving down to Phatthalung and want a simple, good-value room in the centre with somewhere easy to park, City Park Hotel is a name that comes up again and again. It's a long-running 3-star hotel on Padungdonyor Road in the Khuha Sawan area, near Khao Ok Thalu and Khuha Sawan Cave. The 45 air-conditioned rooms are large and clean with private balconies, there's an on-site restaurant and a garden, and there's plenty of free parking. The overall score is 8.6 from real guest reviews (8.9 on Agoda from 943 reviews), from around THB 650/night.

body.html: City Park Hotel is one of those steady, no-surprises hotels right in the centre of Phatthalung that self-drive travellers keep coming back to. The thing reviews mention most is the combination of large, clean rooms and easy, free parking — many guests say the rooms are bigger than they expected for the price, that everything is kept clean, and that there's always space to leave the car or scooter. It sits on Padungdonyor Road in the Khuha Sawan area, a short hop from the town's restaurants and markets, which makes it a practical base for a night or two.

The 45 rooms are air-conditioned with a private balcony, a fridge, a 32-inch flat-screen TV, a hot-and-cold shower and free Wi-Fi. Choices run from a Standard Double or Standard Twin up to a Superior Double and a Deluxe Family Room, so there's something for couples, solo drivers and families. There's an on-site restaurant and coffee shop serving breakfast through dinner, plus a garden and terrace to sit out in. This is a straightforward town hotel built around comfortable rooms and convenience, not a resort with a pool or lake views.
"Central location, the rooms are large and clean, the staff are lovely, and there's plenty of parking. Good value for the price."

The most consistent praise goes to the room size, cleanliness, friendly staff and value. Guests repeatedly call the staff helpful and kind, and several mention how handy the free parking is when arriving by car or motorbike. With an 8.9 score on Agoda from over 900 reviews and 8.8 on Booking, this is a hotel that has earned its reputation over time rather than off the back of a few glowing reviews. For a comfortable, clean room in the middle of Phatthalung at this price, most people leave satisfied.

To be honest, there are a few things to know. There's no lift — a few reviews point out that with no elevator and no luggage trolley, hauling heavy bags up can be a chore, which is worth bearing in mind if you're travelling with a lot of luggage or someone who finds stairs hard. A couple of guests felt their room looked smaller than the photos suggested, and there are occasional notes about a missing item like a hairdryer or toilet paper, and about soundproofing between rooms. The streets immediately around the hotel are ordinary town streets rather than a scenic setting.

Location is a real strength. The hotel is in the Khuha Sawan area, within about a 10-minute walk of Khuha Sawan Cave and Wat Khuha Sawan, and Khao Ok Thalu — Phatthalung's landmark mountain — is roughly 1–2 km away. You're close to the town centre's food and shops, and it's an easy drive out to Thale Noi or Pak Pra if you want to spend a day on the water. For travellers who want to see Phatthalung's in-town sights on foot and drive out to nature, the position works well.

In short, City Park Hotel is best for travellers who want a large, clean, good-value room in central Phatthalung with easy parking — especially anyone arriving by car or motorbike. If you need a lift for heavy bags, want a pool, or are after a quiet, scenic resort by the lake, this isn't the one — look at a stay around Lampam Beach or Pak Pra instead. But as a practical, comfortable town base near Khao Ok Thalu and Khuha Sawan Cave, it's a dependable pick at a wallet-friendly rate.

A tip from following the reviews: if you have heavy luggage, ask for a room on a lower floor, since there's no lift. Pack a few essentials like a hairdryer if you rely on one, just in case, and if you sleep lightly, request a quieter room away from the road. With free parking on site, it's an easy place to base yourself and drive out to Khao Ok Thalu, Khuha Sawan Cave, Thale Noi and Pak Pra.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — City Park Hotel Phatthalung

faq.q: Where is City Park Hotel in Phatthalung, and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 63/6 Padungdonyor Road, Khuha Sawan, Mueang Phatthalung, in the town centre. Khuha Sawan Cave and Wat Khuha Sawan are about a 10-minute walk away, and Khao Ok Thalu is roughly 1.5 km. The railway station is around 8 minutes by car, and it's an easy drive out to Thale Noi or Pak Pra.

faq.q: How much does City Park Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around THB 650/night for a Standard Double, with a Standard Twin (~฿700), a Superior Double (~฿800) and a Deluxe Family Room (~฿1,100). Prices vary by season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does City Park Hotel have a pool and a lift?
faq.a: There's no pool and no lift at City Park Hotel. It does have an on-site restaurant and coffee shop, a garden and terrace, a 24-hour front desk and plenty of free parking. Every room is air-conditioned with a balcony, a fridge and a 32-inch flat-screen TV. If you need a lift for heavy bags, ask for a room on a lower floor.

faq.q: Who is City Park Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for travellers who want a large, clean, good-value room in central Phatthalung with easy free parking — especially self-drive visitors arriving by car or motorbike. If you want a pool, a lift, or a quiet lakeside resort, look at a stay around Lampam Beach or Pak Pra instead.

faq.q: Anything to know before booking City Park Hotel?
faq.a: There's no lift and no luggage trolley, so heavy bags can be a chore — ask for a lower floor. A few reviews say rooms can look smaller than the photos and occasionally miss an item like a hairdryer, and soundproofing could be better. Even so, it scores 8.9 on Agoda from over 900 reviews, so most guests find it good value.
